task: Deploy A/B Test 50/50 (route_v1 vs route_v2) + report endpoint

endpoints.description: A/B variant entry (v1/legacy side) — returns the deterministically selected variant for the request id
A/B variant entry (v2/behavior side) — same experiment, returns the selected variant
counts per variant + split ratio (merges ADR-017 legacy report + CMD-002-A experiment layer)

split.method: MD5 hash of request_id — first hex nibble < 8 -> v2, >= 8 -> v1 (reuses router.should_use_v2; 8 of 16 buckets per variant = 50/50 by construction)

measured.scope: request ids ab-0000..ab-0099 (100 requests, same id space as the CI test)

test_result.e2e_suite: tests/test_ab_test_api.py (runs in GitHub Actions CI on push to main)
assertions: same request_id always maps to same variant (deterministic)
100 live requests -> report total == 100 and v1 percent within 35-65%
report endpoint returns count per variant + split ratio + split_balance
legacy ADR-017 report fields preserved (backward compatible)
test_result.expected_ci: GitHub Actions auto-qa pipeline runs tests/ on push to main
